column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 4 final decision consultation
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: I'll leave the decision of how to settle this to you...
Sorry, but this is one choice you need to make for yourself...
What on earth is going to happen...?
It is a difficult choice...
In any case, I had intended
to leave the decision to you...
What is there to think about!?
The answer has already been decided, hasn't it!?
(Even so...)
(What we had believed to be Lord $$サタン$$'s words...)
(was actually made up by the $$教皇$$...)
Hey, $$お兄ちゃん$$! Let's go home just like this...
and live together, just $$プリカ$$ and you!!
Hmph! Aren't you an idiot!?
If you do not want to become $$サタン$$, kill your companions,
or destroy the $$世界$$...
then kill yourself and save $$この世$$!!
That would make that child happiest...!
If you do not want to become $$サタン$$, kill your companions,
or destroy the $$世界$$, then leave this place...
and continue an ordinary life on the surface. That is one option, isn't it!?
Eating this apple-like $$リンゴ$$...
brings back your $$記憶$$ of the past, right!?
I have lost my old $$記憶$$ too, so...
I was thinking I might ask you to share the $$知恵の実$$ with me!?
Yeah! It does not look like there is any poison in it!?
Are you really $$カイン$$-kun!?
If you are...
you should hurry up and become $$サタン$$ already!?
For a question that determines people's lives...
you should not rely on someone else's opinion; you must
come to an answer yourself!!
Though I made up my own mind long ago...
That hidden staircase is the $$教皇$$'s private shortcut to the surface $$世界$$...
Yes...
Before you decide, perhaps it would be wise to take a look at the surface as it is now!?
Return to the surface for now
Do not return
